sources.name: Doctor's Handwritten Prescription BD Dataset
sources.description: Real-world scanned handwritten prescriptions from outpatient healthcare facilities in Bangladesh.
sources.handwriting_characteristics: Real physician cursive Latin handwriting, rapid ligatures, variable pen strokes
sources.language_script: Latin with occasional Bengali clinical notes
sources.available_annotations: Document-level image scans, raw clinic transcriptions
sources.access_method: Mendeley Data public download / Academic DOI access
known_limitations: Variable scan resolution across clinics (72 to 300 DPI)
No native token-level bounding polygon coordinates in raw release
Occasional regional pharmaceutical trade names specific to South Asia
sources.relevance: Real-world cursive variability benchmark for Phase 5 OCR baseline and Phase 6 extraction.

provenance.provider_organization: BRAC University and RUET Biomedical Informatics Team
provenance.permitted_usage: Academic research, public scientific evaluation, and publication
provenance.attribution_requirements: Cite Jahan et al. (2021) and Mendeley Data repository DOI
provenance.citation: Jahan, N. et al. (2021). Doctor's Handwritten Prescription BD Dataset. Mendeley Data, V1, doi: 10.17632/r3gmvg62cw.1

sources.name: CDSCO Approved Drug Formulations Reference Subset
sources.description: Finite CDSCO-derived reference subset of approved active pharmaceutical ingredients, strengths, and fixed-dose combinations in India for engineering validation.
sources.document_type: Regulatory gazette and drug formulary tables
sources.available_annotations: Generic name, strength, dosage form, indication, approval date
sources.access_method: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India / CDSCO portal
known_limitations: The current implementation uses a finite CDSCO-derived reference subset for engineering validation and provenance testing. It is not a comprehensive representation of all medicines or formulations approved or marketed in India.
sources.relevance: Authoritative knowledge graph ground truth for Phase 7 RAG validation and Indian posology compliance.

provenance.provider_organization: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt of India
provenance.permitted_usage: Public statutory use, health informatics research, clinical reference
provenance.attribution_requirements: Reference Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation, Govt of India
provenance.citation: CDSCO (2024). List of Approved New Drugs and Fixed Dose Combinations in India. Directorate General of Health Services.

sources.name: NLM RxNorm Clinical Nomenclature Subset
sources.description: Clinical drug vocabulary subset linking active ingredients, clinical dose forms, and concept unique identifiers (RxCUI).
sources.available_annotations: Active ingredients, clinical drug components, dose forms, brand aliases
sources.access_method: UMLS Terminology Services / NLM Open Data
known_limitations: RxNorm is U.S.-centric and should not be treated as a comprehensive Indian formulary.
RxNorm 2024-08 is the frozen reference snapshot used by this implementation as a reduced development subset fixture; current NLM releases are newer.
sources.relevance: Standardized posology taxonomy and RxCUI concept grounding for Phase 7.

provenance.provider_organization: National Library of Medicine, National Institutes of Health, USA
provenance.license: UMLS Metathesaurus License / NLM Public Domain for NLM-authored terms (UTS access required for full dataset)
provenance.permitted_usage: Research and health informatics evaluation under UMLS terms; UTS access required for full distribution
provenance.attribution_requirements: RxNorm is provided courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine
provenance.citation: Nelson, S. J. et al. (2011). Normalized names for clinical drugs: RxNorm at 6 years. J Am Med Inform Assoc, 18(4):441-448.

sources.name: ISMP List of Look-Alike Sound-Alike (LASA) Drug Names
sources.description: Authoritative safety registry of confusable medication pairs prone to dispensing errors, with recommended TALL MAN lettering.
sources.handwriting_characteristics: Typeset confusable drug pair tables with orthographic emphasis
sources.available_annotations: Confusable drug pair, confusion mechanism (sound/look), recommended Tall Man lettering
known_limitations: Specific to medication pairs; does not include full prescription context
sources.relevance: Gold-standard evaluation benchmark for Phase 10 LASA detection and Tall Man formatting.

provenance.permitted_usage: Educational and research evaluation for medical error prevention
provenance.citation: ISMP (2023). ISMP's List of Look-Alike Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters. Horsham, PA.

sources.name: IAM Handwriting Database (Form & Line subset)
sources.description: Standard research corpus of English handwritten forms and sentences with word and line bounding boxes.
sources.handwriting_characteristics: Diverse English handwriting styles from over 500 individual writers
sources.available_annotations: Word bounding boxes, transcription text, line segmentations
sources.access_method: Academic registration on University of Bern FKI portal
known_limitations: General English prose (LOB Corpus), not specialized medical or posology notation
sources.relevance: Pre-training and baseline benchmark for cursive HTR performance in Phase 5.

provenance.provider_organization: Research Group on Computer Vision and Artificial Intelligence (FKI), University of Bern
provenance.citation: Marti, U.-V. and Bunke, H. (2002). The IAM-database: an English sentence database for offline handwriting recognition. IEEE PAMI, 24(11):1459-1464.

sources.name: AURA-Rx Calibration & Integration Sample Set
sources.description: A focused collection of 7 synthetic and de-identified outpatient prescription images paired with gold-standard line-item annotations. Designed strictly for functional pipeline testing, deterministic unit/integration testing, UI state rendering calibration, and split leakage verification. Does not constitute a statistically sufficient evaluation benchmark for empirical ML claims (which is scheduled for Phase 12 using large-scale external corpora).
sources.document_type: Prescription document images with clinical line items
sources.handwriting_characteristics: Diverse Latin handwriting styles including clean, cursive, blurred, shadowed, abbreviations, and LASA pairs
sources.language_script: Latin with English, Hindi, and Marathi posology ground truth
sources.available_annotations: Line item text, medicine name, dosage, frequency, route, duration, instructions, bounding boxes, ambiguity flags
known_limitations: Small sample size (N=7); strictly for engineering integration, calibration, and regression testing
Statistically insufficient for calculating clinical sensitivity/specificity or model generalizability claims
sources.relevance: End-to-end integration and calibration benchmark for Phases 3 through 13.

provenance.permitted_usage: Project development, test suites, evaluation benchmarking
provenance.citation: AURA-Rx Engineering Team (2026). Curated De-identified Outpatient Evaluation Benchmark. Capstone Specification.
